newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G10 central bankers seek new top bank supervisor.
newsitem.headline: G10 central bankers seek new top bank supervisor.

text.p: Central bankers from the Group of 10 (G10) industrial nations have started searching for a new banking supervisor to guide international efforts aimed at preventing future financial crises.

To the lament of central bankers, the Italian cabinet last week nominated Tommaso Padoa-Schioppa, the highly respected chairman of the Basle Committee on Banking Supervision since 1993, to head that country's stock market regulator Consob.
